hooks.name: Repo safety check

action.command: git ls-files --error-unmatch .env.local >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "FAIL: .env.local is tracked" || echo "OK: .env.local not tracked"; grep -qxE '\.kiro/?' .gitignore && echo "FAIL: .kiro is ignored" || echo "OK: .kiro is committed"; for s in "Run it locally" "How we used Kiro" "Data and sources" "The one rule"; do grep -q "$s" README.md && echo "OK: README has $s" || echo "FAIL: README missing $s"; done; git status -sb | head -1

hooks.description: Every new session starts by confirming secrets aren't tracked, .kiro is committed, and the README has its key sections.
